content.title: World Music Awards
content.text: Happy 33rd Birthday to the gorgeous, super talented chart-topping, record-breaking, award-winning Singer, Songwriter, Actor, TV Host, Superstar Fashionista and Global Icon, the One & Only #CHEN! CHEN became world famous as the main Vocalist of the top-selling legendary Group #EXO who paved the way for many. He has an incredible voice and is renowned for his powerful high notes, emotional delivery, and wide vocal range, earning him the nickname "Lightning" in the group's superpower-themed lore. CHEN was introduced as the 4th member of EXO on December 29, 2011, and officially debuted with the group on April 12, 2012, with their mini album 'Mama'. He has been instrumental in EXO's rise to fame as one of K-pop's most influential third-generation groups, contributing to over 35 million equivalent album sales across their discography. He has written numerous hits for EXO, including "Promise" (2015), "Touch It" and "Ko Ko Bop" (2017), and "Love Shot" (2018), showcasing his great songwriting talent. In October 2016, with Baekhyun & Xiumin, CHEN became a member of Exo's first sub unit #ExoCBX. The group made a very successful debut with the chart topping EP 'Hey Mama!' CHEN is also a hugely successful Solo Artist in his own right, writing many of his own hits and consistently topping iTunes charts around the world upon each release. In July 2014, he released his first solo song "The Best Luck" an original soundtrack to the SBS drama I't's Okay, That's Love', starring EXO member DO and won the award for "Best OST by a Male Artist" and "Best OST Song" at the 5th So-Loved Awards and the 16th Seoul International Youth Film Festival. CHEN officially debuted as a solo artist in 2019, focusing primarily on heartfelt ballads and R&B-infused tracks, though recent releases show genre experimentation. He has released 4 Korean EPs to date, with a 5th slated for September 29, 2025. In 2019, he released his 1st EP 'April, and a Flower' which topped the Worldwide & European iTunes Album charts & peaked at No. 2 on the Gaon Album Chart in Korea. It spawned the hit single "Beautiful Goodbye" which peaked at #1 on the Gaon Digital chart in Korea. His 2nd EP, 'Dear My Dear' powered by the hit "Shall We?" was released later in 2019 and also topped the Worldwide & European iTunes Album charts and went to #1 on iTunes in 36 countries, debuting at #1 on the Gaon Album chart! On November 14, 2022 CHEN released his 3rd EP, 'Last Scene which topped the Worldwide & European iTunes Album charts and debuted at No. 1 on the Circle Album Chart in Korea with over 85,000 copies sold in its debut week! In 2023, CHEN released his 1st Japan Mini album "Polaris' which debuted at #1 on the Worldwide & European iTunes Album Charts! CHEN joined Baekhyun's label, INB100, in January 2024 to manage his solo activities, and released his 4th EP 'Door' on May 28, 2024, which topped the Worldwide & European iTunes Charts and debuted at #4 on the Circle Albums chart, powered by its hit single "Empty"! In 2025, CHEN performed at the opening of Korea 360 at the Grand Hyatt Dubai, highlighting his international appeal. His digital single "Broken Party", released in April 2025, was ranked among Billboard's "25 Best K-Pop Songs of 2025" for its bold shift to band-driven rock, expanding beyond his ballad roots! His 5th Mini Album 'Arcadia' will be released on Sept. 29 and has a fresh vibe and is different than his previous albums. CHEN has also recorded songs for various television dramas, including "Best Luck" for 'It's Okay, That's Love' (2014) and "Everytime" for 'Descendants of the Sun' (2016). CHEN is also a very talented actor, and in August 2015, he made his musical theatre debut playing the role of Benny in the SM C&C production 'In the Heights'. He also participated in and became the runner-up in the eleventh round of the music television show 'King of Mask Singer' under the alias "Legendary Guitar Man".CHEN has won several accolades including 'Best OST by a male Artist for "Best Luck" in 2014 at the 16th Seoul International Youth Film Festival! In 2017 he won 2 Awards with Dynamic Group for "Nosedive", including 'Best Collab' at the 19th MAMA awards both in 2017 and 'Best Rap/Hip Hop Award' at the 9th MelOn Music Awards! In 2019 he won the 'TOP 10 Asia-Pacific Gold Song of the Year' at the Annual Fresh Asia Music Awards and in 2020 he was honoured with the Male Vocalist Award at the Korea First Brand Awards. In 2022, his song "Last Scene" won Top 20 Song of the Year (Overseas) at the Asian Pop Music Awards!CHEN is also a philanthropist and supports UNICEF. in January 2016, performed John Lennon's song "Imagine" with pianist Steve Barakatt at the Sejong Center for the Performing Arts, as part of UNICEF's "Imagine Project."
